inScope: Request types: annual leave, unpaid leave, late arrival/early leave, overtime, business trip, remote work, missed attendance record
User, department, role and system administration
outOfScope: Attendance capture via fingerprint or face-recognition devices (future integration must be anticipated)
assumptions: About 250 employees across 3 branches (Hanoi, Da Nang, Ho Chi Minh City)
Cloud deployment is preferred over on-premise
The company already operates a corporate email system usable for authentication
Leave policy changes over time and must be configuration-driven
Phase 1 focuses on annual leave, approval and basic reporting, targeting go-live in about 3 months
